for(const ym of[true,false]){const x=ym?new Temporal.PlainYearMonth(2020,2):new Temporal.PlainMonthDay(2,29);const log=[],bag={};for(const key of["calendar","timeZone","day","month","monthCode","year"])Object.defineProperty(bag,key,{get(){log.push(key);return key==="month"?{valueOf(){log.push("number");return 3;}}:undefined;}});const options={get overflow(){log.push("overflow");return {toString(){log.push("string");return "reject";}};}};x.with(bag,options);const expected=ym?"calendar,timeZone,month,number,monthCode,year,overflow,string":"calendar,timeZone,day,month,number,monthCode,year,overflow,string";if(log.join()!==expected)throw 1;let touched=false;try{x.with({}, {get overflow(){touched=true;throw 2;}});throw 3;}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof TypeError)||touched)throw 4;}try{x.with({month:3,monthCode:"M04"},{get overflow(){throw 42;}});throw 5;}catch(e){if(e!==42)throw 6;}}

for(const name of["PlainYearMonth","PlainMonthDay"]){const C=Temporal[name],x=name==="PlainYearMonth"?new C(2023,1):new C(1,31);for(const item of[new Temporal.PlainDate(2023,1,1),new Temporal.PlainTime(),new Temporal.PlainDateTime(2023,1,1),new Temporal.PlainMonthDay(1,1),new Temporal.PlainYearMonth(2023,1),new Temporal.ZonedDateTime(0n,"UTC")]){Object.defineProperty(item,"calendar",{get(){throw 1;}});let ok=false;try{x.with(item);}catch(e){ok=e instanceof TypeError;}if(!ok)throw 2;}let touched=false,ok=false;try{C.prototype.with.call({}, {get calendar(){touched=true;throw 3;}});}catch(e){ok=e instanceof TypeError;}if(!ok||touched)throw 4;class Sub extends C{}const y=name==="PlainYearMonth"?new Sub(2023,1):new Sub(1,31);Object.defineProperty(y,"constructor",{get(){throw 5;}});if(Object.getPrototypeOf(y.with({month:2}))!==C.prototype)throw 6;}

const lo=new Temporal.PlainYearMonth(-271821,4,"iso8601",30),hi=new Temporal.PlainYearMonth(275760,9);if(!lo.with({month:4}).equals(new Temporal.PlainYearMonth(-271821,4)))throw 1;for(const pair of[[lo,3],[hi,10]]){let ok=false;try{pair[0].with({month:pair[1]});}catch(e){ok=e instanceof RangeError;}if(!ok)throw 2;}const md=new Temporal.PlainMonthDay(2,28,"iso8601",2023);if(md.with({day:29},{overflow:"reject"}).day!==29)throw 3;

const one=new Temporal.PlainYearMonth(2020,1),log=[];const other={get calendar(){log.push("calendar");return undefined;},get month(){log.push("month");return 2;},get monthCode(){log.push("monthCode");return undefined;},get year(){log.push("year");return 2021;}};const options={};for(const key of["largestUnit","roundingIncrement","roundingMode","smallestUnit"])Object.defineProperty(options,key,{get(){log.push(key);return undefined;}});one.until(other,options);if(log.join()!=="calendar,month,monthCode,year,largestUnit,roundingIncrement,roundingMode,smallestUnit")throw 1;try{one.until(one,{largestUnit:"week",get smallestUnit(){throw 42;}});throw 2;}catch(e){if(e!==42)throw 3;}for(const unit of["week","day","hour","minute","second","millisecond","microsecond","nanosecond"]){let ok=false;try{one.until(one,{smallestUnit:unit});}catch(e){ok=e instanceof RangeError;}if(!ok)throw 4;}for(const name of["until","since"]){let touched=false,ok=false;try{Temporal.PlainYearMonth.prototype[name].call({}, {get calendar(){touched=true;throw 5;}});}catch(e){ok=e instanceof TypeError;}if(!ok||touched)throw 6;}
